title: DistributedFreeBroadcastSmoothNonconvex.lean

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable, globally lower-bounded objective F on R^d. Nonconvex objectives and components are permitted. The initial gap satisfies F(x0) − lower ≤ Δ.

problem_class.label: finite_sum
problem_class.details: F(x) = (1/n) Σ_i f_i(x), with n ≥ 1 components distributed across n workers.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Gradient evaluations return exact derivatives without stochastic noise; the system seed has a Dirac law.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: Worker i evaluates ∇f_i(x) at a requested point in time h_i > 0. Each worker has at most one pending computation, which can be aborted. The server has no computation oracle.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is Euclidean R^d, with d ≥ 1.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Public parameters include n, d, x0, h_i, l, b, L, Lhat, Δ, G, and ε; component functions are the hidden instance. Here L,Lhat,ε > 0 and Δ,G ≥ 0. Smoothness requires ||∇F(x)−∇F(y)|| ≤ L||x−y|| and (1/n)Σ_i ||∇f_i(x)−∇f_i(y)||² ≤ Lhat²||x−y||². Only initial component gradients are bounded: ||∇f_i(x0)|| ≤ G. Communication uses a star with concurrent independent directed links and one pending message per link. Server-to-worker messages take zero time; a worker uplink carrying m payload bits takes l+b(m+64), including the mandatory 64-bit header, where l,b ≥ 0. Budgets measure elapsed time and algorithms receive 64-bit clock readings.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/DistributedFreeBroadcastSmoothNonconvex.lean: Params, communication, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StarNetwork.lean: communication; LongTails/TemplateDistributed.lean: Time, clockBits, Algorithm, step, TimedConvergence.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm_squared
accuracy.details: Return a measurable point-valued output X with integrable squared Euclidean gradient norm satisfying E[||∇F(X)||²] ≤ ε². No particular iterate-selection rule is required.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Stationarity is required in expectation under the execution law. Algorithmic randomization is permitted despite the deterministic gradient oracle.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The smooth nonconvex finite-sum objective is standard, but the elapsed-time formulation combines heterogeneous computation times, free server broadcasts, finite-bit uplinks with latency and headers, and finite clock readings.

descriptionHtml:
Distributed Nonconvex Optimization with Free Broadcast

We consider minimizing F(x)=n−1∑i=1nfi(x) on Rd, where n,d≥1 are integers and the differentiable functions fi:Rd→R may be nonconvex. The gradient of F is L-Lipschitz, and component gradients are root-mean-square Lipschitz with constant L^, where L,L^>0. At a given point x0, component gradient norms are bounded by G≥0, and the gap above a global lower bound is at most Δ≥0. Worker i returns ∇fi(x) at x on a star network with heterogeneous computation times and free coordinator broadcasts. For ε>0, the goal is EP∥∇F(x¯)∥2≤ε2, where x¯ is the output and P is the law of algorithm randomness.

The optimization problem is infx∈RdF(x). All vector norms are Euclidean. There are n computing workers and one coordinator. Worker i has computation time hi>0; worker-to-coordinator communication has latency ℓ≥0 and time per bit b≥0. The algorithm receives d,n,(hi)i=1n,ℓ,b,L,L^,Δ,G,ε, and x0.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Smoothness). Each fi is differentiable everywhere. For every x,y∈Rd, ∥∇F(x)−∇F(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥,1n∑i=1n∥∇fi(x)−∇fi(y)∥2≤L^2∥x−y∥2.

Assumption 2 (Initial bounds). There exists Flow∈R such that F(x)≥Flowfor every x∈Rd,F(x0)−Flow≤Δ,∥∇fi(x0)∥≤Gfor i=1,…,n.

A gradient query at worker i may use any x∈Rd. If accepted at time t, it returns the queried point and the exact gradient ∇fi(x) at time t+hi. Each worker processes at most one gradient query at a time; further queries while it is occupied are ignored. A pending computation may be canceled. Computations at different workers may proceed concurrently, and the coordinator performs no gradient computations.

Communication uses finite binary messages along the star edges. A message with m payload bits carries an additional 64 bits. Its transmission delay is {0,from the coordinator to a worker,ℓ+b(m+64),from a worker to the coordinator. A broadcast consists of messages from the coordinator to the intended workers, each with zero delay. Each directed edge holds at most one pending message; a further submission on that edge is ignored until delivery. Different directed edges, including opposite directions of the same edge, operate concurrently. Communication may overlap computation, and workers exchange messages through the coordinator.

For an elapsed-time budget T≥0, the algorithm returns a measurable output x¯∈Rd at a designated output node. Almost surely under P, only finitely many computation, communication, and local scheduling events may occur up to each deadline t≤T. The squared gradient norm must be integrable, and the accuracy requirement is EP[∥∇F(x¯)∥2]≤ε2. The budget measures elapsed time, including computation and communication delays.

Our constructions use free shared randomness and uncharged arithmetic/coding, with known setup parameters. Target: ∫∥∇F(xout(ω))∥2dP(ω)≤ε2, under the algorithm’s execution law P.

import LongTails.TemplateDistributed
import LongTails.Setups.StarNetwork
import LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.MeasurableSpace

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.DistributedFreeBroadcastSmoothNonconvex

open DistributedTemplate

structure Params where
  d : ℕ+
  n : ℕ+
  h : Fin n → Time
  l : Time
  b : Time
  L : ℝ
  Lhat : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  G : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

abbrev Point (p : Params) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
abbrev Functions (p : Params) := Fin p.n → Point p → ℝ
abbrev ComputeQuery (p : Params) := StarNetwork.ComputeQuery (Point p)
abbrev ComputeReply (p : Params) := StarNetwork.ComputeReply (Point p) (Point p)
abbrev CommReply (p : Params) := StarNetwork.CommReply p.n

noncomputable def objective (p : Params) (f : Functions p) : Point p → ℝ :=
  FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f

noncomputable def communication (p : Params) : CommunicationOracle (CommReply p) Unit (p.n + 1) :=
  { StarNetwork.communication (Seed := Unit) ⟨p.h, p.l, p.b⟩ with
    submit := fun s time source query =>
      if source = 0 then (StarNetwork.communication (Seed := Unit) ⟨p.h, 0, 0⟩).submit s time source query
      else (StarNetwork.communication (Seed := Unit) ⟨p.h, p.l, p.b⟩).submit s time source query }

noncomputable def system (p : Params) (f : Functions p) :
    Oracle (ComputeQuery p) (ComputeReply p) (CommReply p) (p.n + 1) where
  Seed := Unit
  law := ⟨Measure.dirac (), inferInstance⟩
  computation := StarNetwork.computation ⟨p.h, p.l, p.b⟩ (fun i x (_ : Unit) _ => gradient (f i) x)
  communication := communication p

noncomputable def spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  numWorkers p := p.n + 1
  Instance := Functions
  ComputeQuery := ComputeQuery
  ComputeReply := ComputeReply
  CommReply := CommReply
  Output := Point
  publicInput := id
  valid p := (∀ i, 0 < p.h i) ∧ 0 < p.L ∧ 0 < p.Lhat ∧ 0 ≤ p.Δ ∧ 0 ≤ p.G ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p f O :=
    O = system p f ∧
    (∀ i x, HasGradientAt (f i) (gradient (f i) x) x) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖gradient (objective p f) x - gradient (objective p f) y‖ ≤ p.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∀ x y, (1 / (p.n : ℝ)) * (∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ^ 2) ≤
      p.Lhat ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ i, ‖gradient (f i) p.x0‖ ≤ p.G) ∧
    (∃ lower : ℝ, (∀ x, lower ≤ objective p f x) ∧ objective p f p.x0 - lower ≤ p.Δ)
  successful p f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => ‖gradient (objective p f) (output ω)‖ ^ 2) (P : Measure _) ∧
    (∫ ω, ‖gradient (objective p f) (output ω)‖ ^ 2 ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ p.ε ^ 2

end LongTails.Setups.DistributedFreeBroadcastSmoothNonconvex
